outcome: Histological response/remission to PPI therapy (< 15 eosinophils per high-power field)
Histological characteristics (eosinophil counts, basal zone hyperplasia, eosinophilic abscesses, eosinophil surface layering)
cohort: 34 pediatric patients aged 2-18 years diagnosed with Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) at a tertiary care center in Bogota, Colombia.
finding: 47% (16 out of 34) of pediatric patients with EoE achieved histological remission with initial PPI therapy.
followup_time: at least 8 weeks after initiation of PPI therapy
